writers.name: ଅନ୍ତର୍ଯ୍ୟାମୀ ବେଜ
writers.bio: ଅନ୍ତର୍ଯ୍ୟାମୀ ବେଜ ଜଣେ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଓ ଓଡ଼ିଆ କବିତା ଲେଖକ । ଶିଶୁ କିଶୋରରେ ତାଙ୍କର ‘ବନ ମହୋତ୍ସବ’ କବିତା ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ହୋଇଛି । ଏହି କବିତାରେ ଗଛର ଉପକାରିତା ଓ ପରିବେଶର ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଚାରା ଲଗାଇବାର କଥା ରହିଛି ।
writers.identity: Original October 2026 poem explicitly signs as teacher, Pattamundai, Kendrapara. Teacher role is based on that signature, not a same-name news report. No portrait verified.

notes: Original signed poem confirms teacher role. Read full Van Mahotsav poem. Broad Odia and English searches found limited literary evidence; same-name teacher-protest report not used and no portrait verified.

outcomes.name: କନ୍ଦର୍ପ ବେହେରା
outcomes.reviewScope: Check identity, useful biography additions, and verified photograph; preserve source writing.
notes: Read Hasiba Janama Bhui and Rairakhol signature. Same-name Rairakhol news byline is promising but cannot alone establish poet/reporter identity. Two literary news pages returned 403; indexed excerpt establishes reporter byline, not authorship of the book being launched. Do not attribute that book to him. No named portrait verified.
